name: Oathsteel
description: A metal that hardens under strain, as if it remembers every blow. Yields lighter, tougher plating and an honest blade.

name: Corrodite
description: Weeping green crystal that slowly eats any metal it touches. Bottled under pressure, it strips armor.

name: Bastion Ore
description: Dense, shock-tolerant ore salvaged from siege engines. Makes barrels and launch rails that survive their own recoil.

name: Stormglass
description: Glass that holds a faint charge long after a storm passes. A natural reservoir for Motes of Moment.

name: Skyweave
description: Fibers that pull faintly upward. Woven into actuators, they make legs light and quick, if Wit-hungry.
